author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Current drawing had a lumpy tail with a round bulge under the fin and a stubby wing, so it read as a blob or toy. Redrawn closer to the reference: a straight 10-tall fuselage with a round r5 nose, a swept fin with a vertical trailing edge, an upswept tail underside, and one long swept wing as an outlined 45-degree parallelogram. Clean side-profile airliner at 48.
omissions: Wing-root line inside the fuselage omitted.
